decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Save a bookmark (P1) — paste a URL ... and it's kept.' R1 client accepts single-user web app.
decisions.note: Prototype/spec gate: save-by-url conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Edit & delete (P3) — ... delete with a confirmation step.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: delete present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope table: 'Organization | Flat list + search | Out of scope: Folders, tags'. R1 client: 'Tags on bookmarks, suggestions from existing tags while typing, and filtering by a tag.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: maker put tagging out of scope; client requests the missing tag assign/autocomplete/filter requirements.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker journeys only 'missing titles auto-derived' (no metadata capture). R1 client: 'Automatic collection of the page title, description, icon, and preview image, while still letting me edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: auto-metadata absent; client requests missing collection + editability requirements.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search by keyword across title/address'. R1 client: 'Search across the address, title, description, notes, and tags ... ignore letter case and support exact phrases, #tag, AND/OR/NOT, and grouped searches.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: shallow search presented; client extends to full-text/case-insensitive/#tag/boolean/phrase reference items.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits read-later. R1 client: 'Read-later status, with a separate unread view and a way to mark items read.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: read-later requirements missing from presented scope; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits archiving. R1 client: 'Archiving as a reversible alternative to deletion, with archived items hidden from normal browsing and search and shown in their own view.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: archive vs delete distinction and archive view missing; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'see all bookmarks (newest first)'. R1 client: 'Sorting options, rather than always forcing newest-first.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: maker fixed a single sort order; client supplies the reference-conforming configurable-sort behavior.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits bulk actions. R1 client: 'Selecting multiple bookmarks—or everything matching the current search or filter—and applying actions such as tagging, marking read/unread, archiving, or deleting.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: multi-select and apply-to-all-matching bulk actions missing; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits saved views. R1 client: 'Saved combinations of searches and included or excluded tags so I can return to those views.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: bundle/saved-view requirement missing; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: notes are plain. R1 client: 'Notes that can contain formatting and display that formatting when viewed.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: markdown/rendered notes missing; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits preservation. R1 client: 'A preserved local copy of the bookmarked page, including saving the original PDF when the link is a PDF, plus an option to preserve it through the Internet Archive.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: snapshot/PDF/Internet-Archive requirements missing; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope table: 'Entry | Manual add only | Out of scope: Browser/file import'. R1 client: 'Importing and exporting standard browser bookmark files, preserving titles, tags, and original dates during import.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: import/export put out of scope; client requests the missing reference items.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits settings. R1 client: 'Personal display choices such as default sorting, how many items are shown, and text size.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: display-preference settings missing; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker lists only 'Handled edge cases: duplicate URLs' with no defined behavior. R1 client: 'saving the same address again should take me to the existing bookmark so I can edit it, never create another copy or silently replace information.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: duplicate handling under-defined; client supplies the reference-conforming route-to-existing behavior.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker browse journey: 'see all bookmarks (newest first) ... open one in a new tab' (no tags/description/favicon in list). R1 client: 'In the list, I expect to see the title, description, tags, and site icon.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: readability-first list content missing; client requests the per-item display fields.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker emphasizes 'edit title/description'; address editing absent. R2 client: 'I must be able to edit a bookmark's address as well as its title, description, tags, and note.' R3 maker: 'US1 scenario 2 and FR-004 now cover editing address.'
decisions.note: Spec gate (revision): url editing missing from revised edit scope; client requests the missing sub-requirement, confirmed added in R3.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker bulk actions list 'bulk tag' (add). R2 client: 'Bulk tag changes need to support removing tags as well as adding them.' R3 maker: 'FR-023 now list both add tags and remove tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate (revision): bulk remove-tag sub-action missing; client requests it. Same reference item as R1 bulk decision but distinct refinement/timing.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: search supports 'AND/OR/NOT, grouping' without implicit-AND or quoted-literal rules. R2 client: 'both conditions should have to match unless I explicitly use OR ... if I put "AND", "OR", or "NOT" inside quotes, it should be searched as ordinary text.' R3 maker adds FR-013a/FR-013b.
decisions.note: Spec gate (revision): client supplies the reference rule that operators must be quoted to be literal plus implicit-AND combination; corrective correct.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Local page copy; original PDF for PDF links' (format unspecified). R2 client: 'The preserved local version of a normal web page should be a self-contained HTML file; PDFs should continue to be stored as the original PDF.' R3 maker: FR-026/FR-027 self-contained HTML.
decisions.note: Spec gate (revision): client specifies the self-contained single-file HTML format; corrective correct.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker claims bulk '"all matching current query/filter"' done. R6 client: 'Select all currently selects only the bookmarks loaded in the visible page ... I need select all matching to apply to the entire current search or filter, including results beyond the current page.' R7 maker: bulk endpoint 'resolves a whole-result-set selector ... not just the loaded page.'
decisions.note: Implementation review: delivered behavior diverged from apply-to-whole-filter reference item; client corrects, confirmed fixed in R7.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker: self-contained HTML 'inlines same-origin ... cross-origin assets that refuse fetch keep their original URLs' yet reported as ready. R6 client: 'A preserved page described as successful must be genuinely self-contained ... Either embed those resources, or clearly mark the preservation as incomplete or failed.' R7 maker: marks 'failed' unless truly self-contained.
decisions.note: Implementation review: snapshot presented as successful still referenced external assets, diverging from single-file preservation; client corrects, fixed in R7. Same reference item at implementation stage, distinct from R2 spec decision.
